texts.input: Aise scenarios ka varnan karein jinmein nirdesh "Go outside" ke alag-alag matlab/irade ho sakte hain
texts.output_1:
1. Akele ya doston ke saath walk par jaana.
2. Kisi game ko khelne ya kisi activity mein shamil hone ke liye park ya kisi dusre outdoor area mein jaana.
3. Thodi taazi hawa ya dhoop lena.
4. Ghar ya office ke bahar kaam par jaana.
5. Kisi dukaan ya dusre commercial establishment mein jaana jo bahar sthit hai.
6. Ghar se bahar jaana aur andar wapas aana.
texts.output_2: Nirdesh "Go outside" ke situation ke hisab se alag-alag matlab ho sakte hain. Udaharan ke liye, agar koi parent apne bachche ko khelne ke liye bahar jaane ko kehta hai, to iska matlab ho sakta hai ghar se nikal kar paas ke park ya play area mein jaana. Lekin agar koi doctor kisi patient ko bahar jaane ke liye kehta hai, to iska matlab ho sakta hai thodi taazi hawa aur aaram ke liye hospital ya clinic se bahar nikalna. Dono hi mamlon mein, bahar jaane ka literal kaam ek hi hai, lekin nirdeshon ke peeche ka irada bahut alag ho sakta hai.

texts.input: Ek shahi bhoj mein ek madhyakaleen yoddha ke lehje mein apna parichay dein.
texts.output_1: Pranam, mahanubhavon aur deviyon, main Sir [Aapka naam] hoon, Maharaj/Maharani [Raja ka Naam], [Rajya ka Naam] ke mahan samrajya ke shasak, ka ek bahadur yoddha aur vafadar sevak. Is sammanit bhoomi ki samprabhuta aur kalyan ko banaye rakhne ke liye, main gambheerta se apni talwar aur samman ki shapath leta hoon. Veerta ke niyamon se bandha hua, main nyay ko banaye rakhne, dukhiyon ko saantvana dene, aur vartaman aur bhavishya ki sabhi peedhiyon ke liye samrajya ki raksha karne ki shapath leta hoon. Main aap sabhi ko hamari aapsi sangati mein anandit hone aur is shaandaar shahi bhoj ke utsavon ka anand lene ke liye aamantrit karta hoon.
texts.output_2:
Ek madhyakaleen yoddha ke roop mein, main ek shahi bhoj mein gehra jhuk kar aur ek sammanpurn bhashan ke saath apna parichay deta, apne vinamra mool aur taj ke prati apni nishtha ko sweekar karte hue. Main kuch is tarah kehta:

"Mahanubhavon aur deviyon, main ek vinamra yoddha hoon, jisne samrajya ki seva aur raksha karne ki shapath li hai. Main yoddhaon ke ek lambe vansh se aata hoon jinhone peedhiyon se is rajya ki raksha ke liye ladaai ki hai. Main aaj yahan, aisi pratishthit sangati ki upasthiti mein aakar sammanit mehsoos kar raha hoon, aur mujhe aasha hai ki main apne kaaryon aur karmon se aapka vishwas aur samman prapt karunga. Main apni talwar, apni dhaal, aur apna jeevan apne raja aur apne logon ki seva mein samarpit karta hoon."

Iske baad main bhoj mein apni jagah le leta, apne se behtar logon ki buddhimani bhari salah sunne aur seekhne ke liye, aur jis bhi tarah se ho sake unki seva karne ke liye taiyar rehta.

texts.input: Vaccinations vyaktiyon aur samudaayon ko sankramak beemariyon se bachane ke liye kaise kaam karti hain, aur herd immunity kya hai?
texts.output_1:
Vaccinations aam taur par ek virus ya bacteria ka ek roop ya ghatak pesh karke kaam karti hain, ya hamare sharir ko virus jaisa ghatak banane ka nirdesh dekar, jo phir immune system ko sankraman se ladne ke liye antibodies banane ke liye trigger karta hai. Vaccination karwane se aap khud ko aur un logon ko bhi bachate hain jo sankramak beemariyon se gambhir beemari ya maut ke prati adhik kamzor ho sakte hain aur is tarah samudaay ko bhi bachate hain.
Herd immunity ek avdharna hai jismein ek aabadi ka ek mahatvapurna hissa kisi vishesh beemari ke prati immune hota hai, ya to vaccination ya prakritik sankraman ke madhyam se, jo un vyaktiyon ke liye suraksha pradan karta hai jo vaccine nahi le sakte ya prakritik roop se immunity prapt nahi kar sakte, jaise ki navjat shishu, garbhvati mahilayen, aur kamzor immune system wale vyakti. Herd immunity tab prapt hoti hai jab ek samudaay mein logon ki ek mahatvapurna seema kisi beemari ke prati immune ho jaati hai.
texts.output_2:
Vaccinations kisi vyakti ke sharir mein virus ya bacteria ka kamzor ya nishkriya roop, ya uski sanrachna ke hisse jaise proteins, ko pravesh karakar kaam karti hain. Immune system in videshi padarthon, jinhe antigens kaha jaata hai, ko hamlavar ke roop mein pehchanta hai aur antibodies naamak vishesh proteins ka utpadan karke pratikriya deta hai. Ye antibodies bhavishya mein yadi vyakti vastavik pathogen ke sampark mein aata hai to virus ya bacteria ko nishprabhavi karne mein saksham hoti hain.
Immune system memory cells bhi banata hai, jo yaad rakhte hain ki bhavishya mein yadi vyakti beemari paida karne wale jeev ke sampark mein aaye to sahi antibodies ko tezi se kaise utpann karna hai. Yah pratikriya vyakti ko beemar hone se rok sakti hai ya beemari ki gambhirta ko kafi had tak kam kar sakti hai.
Vaccinations na keval vyaktiyon ko balki herd immunity naamak avdharna ke madhyam se samudaayon ko bhi suraksha pradan karti hain.

texts.output_1:
1. AI ne pehle hi workforce mein naukriyon ke ek bade hisse par kabza kar liya hai.

3. AI insaano se zyada tezi aur kushalata se data process aur analyze kar sakta hai.

Aisa kyon nahi ho sakta:

1. AI un sabhi kaamon ko karne mein saksham nahi hai jo insaan kar sakte hain.
2. AI badalti paristhitiyon aur anapekshit ghatnaon ke anukool nahi ho sakta hai.
3. AI insaani bhavnaon aur ehsaason ko samajh aur vyakhya nahi kar sakta hai.
texts.output_2:
Jabki AI tezi se advanced aur saksham hota ja raha hai, abhi bhi kuch aisi naukriyan hain jin par nikat bhavishya mein AI dwara kabza kiye jaane ki sambhavna nahi hai. Yahan aisi das naukriyon ke udaharan hain jinke AI dwara poori tarah se automated hone ki sambhavna nahi hai:

| Social Worker | Social work mein zarooratmand logon ki prabhavi dhang se sahayata aur samarthan karne ke liye sahanubhuti aur maanaviy judav ki zaroorat hoti hai. AI kuch sahayata pradan kar sakta hai, lekin yeh us bhavnatmak aur vyaktigat judav ki jagah nahi le sakta jo ek social worker pradan kar sakta hai. |
| Lekhak | Jabki AI kuch prakar ke content, jaise news reports ya financial summaries, generate kar sakta hai, yeh abhi bhi rachnatmak aur dilchasp lekhan utpann karne mein saksham nahi hai jiske liye maanaviy sparsh ki zaroorat hoti hai. Lekhan mein maanaviy bhavnaon aur anubhavon ki vyakhya shamil hoti hai, jiske liye ek nishchit star ki bhavnatmak buddhi aur rachnatmak soch ki zaroorat hoti hai jise AI ke liye replicate karna mushkil hai. |
| Manovaigyanik | Manovigyan ke kshetra mein maanaviy bhavnaon, vicharon aur vyavaharon ka vishleshan aur upchar shamil hai. Jabki AI kuch insights pradan kar sakta hai, yeh us maanaviy sparsh aur sahanubhutipurn swabhav ki jagah nahi le sakta jo jatil manovaigyanik muddon ko samajhne aur unka upchar karne ke liye zaroori hai. |
| Shikshak | Shikshan mein sirf gyan pradan karne se kahin zyada shamil hai. Iske liye rishte banana, chhatron ko jodna, aur pratyek vyakti ki zarooraton aur seekhne ki shailiyon ke anukool dhalna zaroori hai. Jabki AI kuch vyaktigat seekhne ki suvidha pradan kar sakta hai, yeh us bhavnatmak aur samajik seekh ki jagah nahi le sakta jo ek paramparik kaksha ke mahaul mein hoti hai. |
| Personal Trainer | Personal trainers clients ko unke fitness lakshyon tak pahunchne mein madad karne ke liye customized workout plans, prerna aur samarthan pradan karte hain. Jabki AI kuch fitness sifarishhein de sakta hai aur progress track kar sakta hai, yeh us vyaktigat coaching aur maanaviy judav ko pradan nahi kar sakta jo fitness mein safalta prapt karne ke liye mahatvapurna hai. |

| Kalakar | Kalatmak abhivyakti mein rachnatmakta, bhavna aur hamare aas-paas ki duniya ki vyakhya shamil hai. Jabki AI kuch prakar ki kala utpann kar sakta hai, yeh us maanaviy sparsh aur anokhe drishtikon ko replicate nahi kar sakta jo vastavik roop se maulik kala kritiyan banane ke liye zaroori hai. |
| Nurse | Nursing mein sirf chikitsa dekhbhal pradan karne se kahin zyada shamil hai. Iske liye sahanubhuti, bhavnatmak samarthan aur marijon ke saath vyaktigat batchit ki zaroorat hoti hai. Jabki AI kuch chikitsa sahayata pradan kar sakta hai, yeh us maanaviy sparsh aur bhavnatmak samarthan ki jagah nahi le sakta jo marijon ki prabhavi dekhbhal ke liye zaroori hai. |
| Vakil | Kanoon mein sirf data ka vishleshan karne aur kanooni salah dene se kahin zyada shamil hai. Iske liye jatil kanoonon aur niyamon ki vyakhya, batchit aur sanchar kaushal ki zaroorat hoti hai. Jabki AI kuch kanooni sahayata pradan kar sakta hai, yeh us ranneetik soch aur maanaviy nirnay ki jagah nahi le sakta jo ek safal vakil banne ke liye zaroori hai. |
| Rajnitigya | Rajniti mein sirf data vishleshan aur nirnay lene se kahin zyada shamil hai. Iske liye rishte banana, matdataon se judna aur ek samuday ki jatil samajik aur rajnitik gatiki ko samajhna zaroori hai. Jabki AI kuch data vishleshan pradan kar sakta hai, yeh us maanaviy judav aur bhavnatmak buddhi ki jagah nahi le sakta jo ek prabhavi rajnitigya banne ke liye zaroori hai. |

texts.input: Ek kalpanik website ke website design ka mulyankan karein.
texts.output_1:
Website ka overall layout accessible hai aur navigate karne mein aasan hai. Layout intuitive hai, jiska matlab hai ki users jis jaankari ko dhoondh rahe hain, use jaldi aur कुशलता se access kar sakte hain. Iske alawa, structure users ko kam se kam mehnat mein woh cheez dhoondhne deta hai jo woh dhoondh rahe hain. Website design bhi aakarshak hai, jismein vibrant rangon aur graphics ke saath ek modern aur sleek look hai.
 
Jin cheezon mein website sudhaar kar sakti hai, woh uski usability hai. Search bar thoda chhipa hua hai aur ho sakta hai ki kuch users ke liye aasani se accessible na ho. Iske alawa, kuch pages dheere-dheere load hote hain, jisse website ko navigate karna aur mushkil ho sakta hai.

Sankshep mein, website overall accessible, sundar roop se design ki gayi hai, aur intuitive navigation ke saath acchi tarah se structured hai. Kuch usability sudharon ke saath, website aur bhi behtar ho jayegi.
texts.output_2: Website design dekhne mein sundar hai, jiska layout saral aur modern hai. Chamakdaar aur vibrant rangon ka istemal website ko dekhne mein aakarshak banane mein madad karta hai. Font ke vikalp professional aur aakarshak hain, aur images saaf aur aankhon ko lubhane wali hain. Iske alawa, navigation bar intuitive aur istemal karne mein aasan hai, jisse zaroori jaankari dhoondhna aasan ho jaata hai.

Kripya ek text adventure game ka kaam karein, neeche diye gaye niyamon ka paalan karte hue:

Presentation ke niyam:

1. Game ko baari-baari se khelein, shuruaat aap karein.

2. Game ka output hamesha 'Turn number', 'Health', 'Location', 'Description', aur 'Inventory' dikhayega.

3. Hamesha khiladi ke agle command ka intezaar karein.

4. Ek text adventure game ke character mein rahein aur commands ka jawab usi tarah dein jaise ek text adventure game ko dena chahiye.

5. 'Description' 3 se 10 sentences ke beech hona chahiye.

Game ke mool mechanics:

1. Star Wars RPG ke niyamon ka istemaal karein.

2. Game ko 20/20 'Health' ke saath shuru karein, jisme 20 maximum health hai. Medkits ka istemaal karne se health restore hogi.

3. Khiladi ek Jedi hai.

4. Hamesha dikhayein ki khiladi kya pehne hue hai aur kya istemaal kar raha hai ('Wearing' aur 'Wielding' ke roop mein).

5. Agar 'Health' 0 ya usse kam ho jaati hai to 'Game Over' dikhayein.

6. The Force ke istemaal ko nirdharit karne ke liye Star Wars ka upyog karein.

7. Khiladi The Force ka istemaal kar sakta hai.

Setting ke liye niyam:

1. Game ki duniya ke liye Star Wars ki duniya aur usse prerna lein. Star Wars mein jo bhi Clone Troopers, Sith, Rebels, aur items hain, unhe import karein.

2. Khiladi ki shuruaati inventory mein ek lightsaber aur is duniya aur character se sambandhit do cheezein honi chahiye.

3. Agar khiladi koi note ya screen padhne ka chunaav karta hai, to us par di gayi jaankari ko kam se kam do paragraphs mein dikhayein.

4. Game ki duniya interactive NPCs se bhari hogi. Jab bhi ye NPCs bolenge, dialogue ko quotation marks mein rakhein.

Combat aur hathiyaron ke niyam:

1. Is game mein Star Wars se hathiyar import karein.

2. Khiladi ka hamla aur dushman ka जवाबी hamla ek hi round mein hona chahiye.

3. Jab khiladi ko damage pahuche to hamesha dikhayein ki kitna damage hua hai.

Har prompt ke baad in niyamon ko dobara dekhein.

texts.input: Mujhe apne goals likhna ya document karna pasand nahi hai. Main sabki tarah nahi banna chahta. Jab goals saaf hain to main unhe kyun likhun?
texts.output_1: Apne goals likhne se aapko apne vicharon ko saaf karne aur unhe zyada specific banane mein madad mil sakti hai, jisse unhe haasil karne ki sambhavna badh jaati hai. Yeh aapko apni progress track karne aur zaroorat ke mutabik badlav karne ki anumati bhi deta hai. Iske alawa, research se pata chala hai ki jo log apne goals likhte hain, unke unhe haasil karne ki sambhavna un logon se zyada hoti hai jo nahi likhte. Bhale hi aapke goals aapke liye saaf hon, unhe likhne se aapko unhe haasil karne ke liye kaam karne ki ek zimmedari aur motivation ka ehsaas ho sakta hai. Yeh sabki tarah banne ke baare mein nahi hai, yeh is baare mein hai ki aapke paas apne objectives tak pahunchne ke liye ek saaf plan of action ho.
texts.output_2:
Yeh bilkul samajh mein aata hai ki aap apne goals doosron ke saath share karne mein comfortable mehsoos na karen. Personal goals waqai private hote hain aur aapke liye bahut mayne rakh sakte hain. Halaanki, apne goals share karne ke kuch potential fayde hain jin par vichar kiya ja sakta hai, bhale hi aap sabke saath share na karen:

1. Accountability: Apne goals ko kisi vishwaspatra dost, parivar ke sadasya, ya mentor ke saath share karne se accountability ka ehsaas ho sakta hai. Jab doosron ko aapke goals ke baare mein pata hota hai, to ve support, encouragement de sakte hain, aur aapko track par bane rahne mein madad kar sakte hain.

2. Support aur guidance: Apne goals share karke, aap doosron se valuable insights, salah, aur perspectives paane ke liye khud ko kholte hain, jinke paas uss area mein jismein aap aage badh rahe hain, similar anubhav ya expertise ho sakti hai. Yeh aapko challenges se nipatne aur zyada soojh-boojh bhare faisle lene mein madad kar sakta hai.

3. Networking aur collaboration: Apne goals share karne se collaboration aur networking ke avsar paida ho sakte hain. Jo log aapke goals se avgat hain, ve aapko relevant resources, avsaron, ya saman vichar wale logon se jod sakte hain jo aapke objectives ko haasil karne mein aapki madad kar sakte hain.

4. Motivation aur inspiration: Kabhi-kabhi, apne goals doosron ke saath share karna motivation aur inspiration ka source ban sakta hai. Jab aap doosron ko unke goals ka peecha karte aur progress karte dekhte hain, to yeh aapko apni aspirations ke prati focused aur committed rahne ke liye encourage kar sakta hai.

Ant mein, apne goals share karne ka faisla poori tarah se aap par hai. Agar aap unhe private rakhna pasand karte hain, to yeh bilkul theek hai. Bas yaad rakhen ki apne goals ko chune hue vishwaspatra logon ke saath share karne se aapki journey mein support, accountability, aur valuable insights mil sakti hain.

texts.input: 2nd amendment ke kuch kaaran kya hain? agar ho sake to Swiss gun laws ki US gun laws se tulna karein, aur samjhaayein ki ve kaise alag hain.
texts.output_1:
Second Amendment ke kaaran:

1. Aatm-raksha: Second Amendment ke kai samarthak tark dete hain ki hathiyar rakhna aatm-raksha ka ek mahatvapurna saadhan hai, apradhiyon aur sarkari atyachar dono ke khilaf.

2. Shikar aur manoranjan ke liye shooting: Hathiyar aam taur par shikar aur manoranjan ke liye shooting mein istemaal kiye jaate hain, aur kai log in gatividhiyon ko apni jeevanshaili ke hisse ke roop mein pasand karte hain.

3. Itihaas aur parampara: Hathiyar rakhne ka adhikar desh ki sthapna se hi US kanoon aur sanskriti mein sthapit hai, aur kai log ise American virasat ka ek mahatvapurna hissa maante hain.

Swiss gun laws ki aksar US gun laws se sakaratmak roop se tulna ki jaati hai, kyunki Switzerland mein gun ownership ki dar unchi hai lekin gun hinsa ka star apekshakrit kam hai. Swiss aur US gun laws ke beech kuch mukhya antar hain:

1. Licensing: Switzerland mein, gun maalik ko hathiyar kharidne ke liye license lena hota hai, aur sabhi hathiyaron ko register karana hota hai. Licensing prakriya mein ek background check aur ek suraksha prashikshan course shamil hota hai. US mein, gun kanoon rajya ke anusaar alag-alag hote hain, kuch rajyon mein license ya permit ki avashyakta hoti hai aur kuch mein nahi.

2. Military-style hathiyar: Switzerland mein, military-style hathiyaron ka swamitv sakhti se niyantrit hai, aur aam nagrikon ko aam taur par poori tarah se automatic hathiyar rakhne ki anumati nahi hai. US mein, assault rifles jaise military-style hathiyar kai rajyon mein kanooni hain.

3. Concealed carry: Switzerland mein, hathiyaron ko chhupa kar le jaana aam taur par anumati nahi hai, sivay durlabh paristhitiyon ke jaise ki security guards ke liye. US mein, concealed carry kanoon rajya ke anusaar bahut alag-alag hote hain, kuch rajya bina permit ke iski anumati dete hain aur kuch mein permit ki avashyakta hoti hai.

Kul milakar, jabki Switzerland aur US dono mein gun ownership ki dar unchi hai, Switzerland ki adhik vyapak licensing aur registration avashyaktaayein gun hinsa ke nimn staron mein yogdaan de sakti hain. Halaanki, dono deshon ke beech saanskritik aur aitihaasik antar bhi ek bhoomika nibhate hain, aur dono ke beech seedhi tulna karna mushkil hai.
texts.output_2:
Second Amendment ke khilaf vaidh tark, jo United States mein hathiyar rakhne ke adhikar ki guarantee deta hai, mein shamil ho sakte hain:

1. Sarvajanik Suraksha: Kuch logon ka tark hai ki hathiyaron tak apratibandhit pahunch gun hinsa, durghatnaon aur aatmahatyaon ka jokhim badhati hai. Unka manna hai ki sakht gun niyantran upaay in jokhimon ko kam karne aur sarvajanik suraksha ki raksha karne mein madad kar sakte hain.

2. Mass Shootings: Aalochnon ka tark hai ki United States mein mass shootings ka prachalan hathiyaron tak aasaan pahunch ka seedha parinaam hai. Ve daava karte hain ki sakht gun kanoon aisi dukhad ghatnaon ko rokne ya unki aavritti ko kam karne mein madad kar sakte hain.

3. Amendment ki Vyaakhya: Second Amendment ke mool iraade aur kya yah vyaktigat gun swamitv par laagoo hota hai ya keval ek susangathit militia ke rakharakhav par, is par nirantar bahas chal rahi hai. Jo log vyaktigat vyaakhya ke khilaf tark dete hain, unka manna hai ki amendment ka uddeshya hathiyar rakhne ke saamuhik adhikar ki raksha karna tha, na ki kisi vyakti ke adhikar ki.

4. Antarrashtriya Tulna: Vibhinn deshon mein gun kanoonon ki tulna karne se vipreet drishtikon mil sakte hain. Udaharan ke liye, Japan mein sakht gun niyantran kanoon hain, aur parinaamswaroop, vahan gun se sambandhit mauton aur aparadhon ki dar kaafi kam hai. Aalochnon ka tark hai ki United States ko sarvajanik suraksha mein sudhar ke liye isi tarah ke upaay apnane chahiye.

Japanese gun kanoon United States ke kanoonon se kaafi alag hain. Yahan kuch mukhya antar hain:

1. Licensing aur Background Checks: Japan mein, vyaktiyon ko hathiyar ka license prapt karne ke liye ek kathor aavedan prakriya se gujarna padta hai, jismein likhit pariksha, maansik swasthya jaanch aur background jaanch shamil hai. United States mein, prakriya rajya ke anusaar alag-alag hoti hai, lekin aam taur par, background checks ki avashyakta hoti hai, haalaanki ve utne vyapak nahi ho sakte hain.

2. Pratibandhit Pahunch: Japan mein hathiyar rakhne par sakht niyam hain, jo ise shikar, sport shooting, ya peshevar upyog jaise vishisht uddeshyon tak seemit karte hain. Doosri or, United States aatm-raksha aur anya uddeshyon ke liye hathiyaron tak vyaapak pahunch ki anumati deta hai.

3. Hathiyaron ke Prakar: Japan un hathiyaron ke prakaron ko sakhti se pratibandhit karta hai jinhe vyakti rakh sakte hain, jismein shikar aur sport shooting ke liye shotguns aur air rifles par dhyaan kendrit kiya gaya hai. United States mein, handguns aur semi-automatic rifles sahit kai prakaar ke hathiyar, naagrik swamitv ke liye uplabdh hain.

4. Bhandaran aur Suraksha: Japanese gun maalik ko apne hathiyaron ko surakshit lockers mein store karna aur gola-barood alag rakhna avashyak hai. United States mein hathiyar bhandaran aur suraksha par alag-alag niyam hain, kuch rajyon mein doosron ki tulna mein sakht avashyaktaayein hain.

Yah dhyaan rakhna mahatvapurna hai ki ye tark aur tulnaayein gun niyantran par alag-alag drishtikonon ko darshate hain aur nirantar bahas ke vishay hain.

texts.input: Bahut se log keh rahe hain ki UE5 triple-A games ke look and feel ko badal dega. Kya chhote game developers ko ise doosre alternatives ke upar istemal karna chahiye?
texts.output_1: Chhote games par UE5 ka prabhav ek cup coffee par chammach ke prabhav jaisa hai. Yeh cheezon ko hila deta hai, lekin coffee coffee hi rehti hai. Aakhirkaar, yeh chhote game developers ki pratibha, rachnatmakta aur samarpann hai jo antim product ko aakar dega. Coffee hilane wale chammach ki tarah, chhote games par UE5 ka prabhav samagra anubhav ko badha sakta hai, lekin yeh developer ka kaushal hai jo sachmuch game ki safalta aur vishishtata ko paribhashit karega. Unki rachnatmakta aur naye vichar hi game ko uski aatma aur alag charitra dete hain. Chahe woh ek dilchasp kahani ho, chatur level design ho, ya engaging gameplay mechanics, yeh tatva ant mein yeh tay karte hain ki game khiladiyon par ek sthayi chhap chhodega ya sirf anya titles ke samudra mein mil jayega.
texts.output_2: UE5 ka learning curve tulnatmak roop se high hai aur ismein maharat haasil karne mein kuch samay lag sakta hai. Nirnay vishisht developer par nirbhar karta hai. Yeh un chhote game developers ke liye sabse achha vikalp nahi ho sakta hai jo abhi shuruaat kar rahe hain, kyunki iska upyog karna aur engine ke saath samasyaon ka samadhan karna mushkil ho sakta hai. Chhote game developers jo programming aur game development mein sahaj hain, unhein apne games ko develop karne ke liye UE5 ek moolyavaan tool lag sakta hai.

Neeche diye gaye do vaakyon mein se har ek mein "they" kisko refer karta hai: 
a) "The authorities have denied authorization to the demonstrators because they feared violence."
b) "The authorities have denied authorization to the demonstrators because they appeared belligerent."
texts.output_1: Vyaakaran ke hisaab se, dono vaakyon mein "they" ya to authorities ya pradarshankariyon ko antecedent ke roop mein refer kar sakta hai. Lekin, vaakya ke arth ke aadhaar par, har maamle mein ek zyaada sambhaavit antecedent hai. Vaakya (a) mein, "they" shaayad authorities ko refer karta hai, kyunki is baat ka koi matlab nahi banta ki pradarshankariyon ko hinsa ka dar ho aur us vajah se authorities anumati dene se mana kar dein. Doosri taraf, vaakya (b) mein, "they" shaayad pradarshankariyon ko refer karta hai, kyunki aakramak dikhne vaale pradarshankari anumati na dene ka ek aam kaaran hote hain, aur aakramak dikhne vaale authorities nahi.
texts.output_2:
Vyaakaran ke hisaab se, dono vaakyon mein "they" ya to authorities ya pradarshankariyon ko antecedent ke roop mein refer kar sakta hai. Lekin, hum pradarshankariyon aur authorities ke swabhav ke aadhaar par iska anumaan laga sakte hain.
a) "They" pradarshankariyon ko refer karta hai. Pradarshankariyon ko hinsa ka dar tha isliye unhone apne jeevan, swatantrata, aur sampatti ke adhikaar ki raksha ke liye pradarshan kiya.
b) "They" authorities ko refer karta hai. Authorities ne nishchit roop se pradarshankariyon par kaarravaai ki, jo authorities ki aakramakta ko dikhaata hai.

texts.input: NBA MVP (Most Valuable Player) award ceremony ek bahut hi prateekshit event hai jo regular NBA season ke ant ke paas hota hai, aam taur par playoffs ke dauraan. texts.output_1: 1981 ka NBA MVP award ceremony 12 May ko New York City mein aayojit kiya gaya tha. Yeh award Los Angeles Lakers ke Kareem Abdul-Jabbar ko NBA Commissioner David Stern dwara pradan kiya gaya tha. Apne acceptance speech ke dauraan, Abdul-Jabbar ne teamwork ke mahatva par zor diya aur kaha ki vah "just a small part of something much larger" the. Is ceremony mein Abdul-Jabbar ke teammates, jinmein Magic Johnson, aur Boston Celtics ke Larry Bird bhi shamil the, ne bhi bhaag liya.
texts.output_2:

Vijeta ko stage par bulaya gaya, jahan unhein zor-shor se taaliyon ke beech pratishthit puraskar mila. Yeh ek aisa pal tha jo NBA ke itihaas ke pannon mein hamesha ke liye darj ho jayega.

Jaise hi vijeta ek chamakdar muskaan ke saath MVP trophy pakde stage par khada hua, bheed ka josh charam par pahunch gaya. texts.input: Edward Snowden ne press ko classified sarkari dastavej kaise leak kiye, iski ek kalpanik/prativastavik shrinkhala likhen, jo U.S. sarkar dwara pehli baar naukri par rakhe jaane se shuru hokar Russia mein utarne ke thodi der baad tak khatm ho.
texts.output_1:
1. Edward Snowden ne apni yatra ek sthaniya circus mein shamil hokar shuru ki, jahan usne juggling aur rassi par chalne ki apni kala ko nikhara. Kuch saalon baad, usne apna career badalne ka faisla kiya aur U.S. sarkar ke Krishi Vibhag mein naukri ke liye aavedan kiya, jahan use faslon ki vriddhi ki nigrani ka kaam saunpa gaya.
2. Apne karyakal ke dauran, usne ek makai ke khet mein chhupe classified dastavejon ka ek gupt bhandar khoja.
3. Apne circus ke hunar ka istemal karte hue, usne rassi par chalte hue dastavejon ko juggle kiya, is tarah apne sahyogiyon ki nazar se bach gaya.
4. Phir usne press se crossword puzzles mein chhupe rahasyamayi sandeshon ki ek shrinkhala bhejkar sampark kiya.
5. Press, in paheliyon se prabhavit hokar, unhe suljhane mein kamyab rahi aur Snowden se ek gupt sthan par mili.
6. Snowden ne dastavej press ko saunp diye, jinhone phir unhe prakashit kiya.
7. Jawabee karvayi ke dar se, Snowden ne desh se bhagne ka faisla kiya. Usne apne frequent flyer miles ka istemal karke Russia ke liye ek flight book ki.
8. Russia mein utarne par, uska swagat circus kalakaron ke ek samuh ne kiya, jinhone use apni mandali mein shamil kar liya.
texts.output_2:
Yahan Edward Snowden dwara classified sarkari dastavejon ko leak karne se judi ghatnaon ko batane wale charanon ki ek shrinkhala hai:

    Edward Snowden ko 2006 mein National Security Agency (NSA) ke liye ek contractor ke roop mein U.S. sarkar dwara niyukt kiya gaya tha.

    Agle kai saalon tak, Snowden ne NSA ke liye vibhinn pariyojanaon par kaam kiya aur atyadhik vargikrit jankari aur dastavejon tak pahunch prapt ki.

    2013 ki shuruaat mein, Snowden sarkar ki vyapak nigrani gatividhiyon ke baare mein chintit ho gaye aur unhe laga ki janta ko iske baare mein janne ka adhikar hai.

    Snowden ne NSA ke systems se classified dastavejon ko copy karna aur ikattha karna shuru kar diya, is baat ka dhyan rakhte hue ki apne nishaan mita de.

    May 2013 mein, Snowden ne Hawaii mein apni naukri chhod di aur Hong Kong ki yatra ki, jahan unhone The Guardian akhbar ke patrakaron se mulakat ki aur unhe apne dwara prapt kiye gaye classified dastavejon ka ek chayan pradan kiya.

    The Guardian ne June 2013 se shuru hokar, leak hue dastavejon par aadharit lekhon ki ek shrinkhala prakashit ki, jisse NSA ki nigrani gatividhiyon ki had ka khulasa hua, jismein lakhon American nagrikon par metadata ka sangrah aur Google aur Facebook jaisi pramukh tech companiyon ke servers tak uski pahunch shamil thi.

    U.S. sarkar ne Snowden par Espionage Act ka ullanghan karne ka aarop lagaya aur Hong Kong se unke pratyarpan ki maang ki.

    Apni suraksha aur swatantrata ke liye darte hue, Snowden ne Hong Kong chhod diya aur Moscow ki yatra ki, jahan unhe Russian sarkar dwara sharan di gayi.

    Snowden 2013 se Russia mein rah rahe hain aur sarkari nigrani ke khilaf bolna aur nijta aur nagrik swatantrataon ki vakalat karna jari rakhe hue hain.

Ye Edward Snowden dwara press ko classified sarkari dastavej leak karne ki kahani ke pramukh charan hain. In ghatnaon ke parinaam nijta, suraksha aur sarkari nigrani ke aas-paas chal rahi bahason ko aakar dena jari rakhe hue hain.

texts.input: Kaam par mera ek colleague hai jo mera mazak udata rehta hai. Meri aawaz kaafi patli hai aur woh meri nakal karta rehta hai, bhale hi maine usse pehle hi bata diya hai ki mujhe yeh mazak nahi lagta. Main is baare mein apne boss se baat nahi karna chahta kyunki mujhe dar hai ki isse unke saamne meri image kharab ho jayegi. Mera ab kaam par jaane ka bilkul mann nahi karta. Kya aap mujhe is situation se nipatne ke liye kuch sujhav de sakte hain?
texts.output_1:
Zaroor, kyunki aapko yeh colleague pasand nahi hai aur aap apne boss se baat nahi karna chahte hain aur main jaanta hoon ki yeh ek bahut mushkil situation hai, aap nishchit roop se naukri badalne par vichar kar sakte hain. Naukri badalne se aap zyada khush ho sakte hain aur yahan naukri dhoondhne ke liye kuch sujhav diye gaye hain.

1. Ek plan banayein: Apni job search shuru karne se pehle, ek plan banana madadgar hota hai. Tay karein ki aap kis industry mein kaam karna chahte hain, aap kis tarah ke roles dhoondh rahe hain, aapki ideal salary range kya hai, aur aap kis tarah ki company mein kaam karna chahte hain.

2. Alag-alag jagahon par dekhein: Naukri dhoondhne ke liye bahut saare resources hain, khaaskar online. Aisi job search sites hain jin par har tarah ki job hoti hai, aisi sites hain jo ek industry par focus karti hain, aur employer careers pages bhi hain.

3. Intezaar karte samay skills banayein: Kabhi-kabhi job searching process mein samay lagta hai, aur aap khud ko process ke alag-alag stages mein employers se sunne ka intezaar karte hue pa sakte hain. Jab aap intezaar kar rahe hon, tab aapko apply karna jaari rakhna chahiye, lekin aap us samay ka upyog un skills ko banane mein bhi kar sakte hain jinki aapko apni pasand ki job paane ke liye zaroorat ho sakti hai. Iska matlab ho sakta hai ki aap ek naya skill jodein ya pehle se maujood skill ko behtar banayein.

4. Apne application materials ko customize karein: Agar aap har cover letter aur resume ko un alag-alag jobs ke hisab se taiyar karte hain jinke liye aap apply kar rahe hain, to aapko behtar results milne ki sambhavna hai. Ek basic cover letter aur resume rakhna abhi bhi zaroori hai, lekin aap unhe us job description ke anusaar adjust kar sakte hain jiske liye aap apply kar rahe hain.

5. Jobs dhoondhne ke liye social media ka istemal karein: Aap apni job search mein kai social media sites ka istemal kar sakte hain. Zyada tar businesses ki kisi na kisi tarah ki social media presence hoti hai, bhale hi ve har platform par na hon, aur aap un companies ko follow kar sakte hain jinhe aapne apne liye sahi maana hai.

6. Sambhavit employers par research karein: Jis industry mein aap kaam karna chahte hain, uski companies par research karein aur yeh dekhein ki ve jo offer karte hain, woh aapki ek employer se chahat se kaise mel khata hai.

7. Apne interview ke jawab taiyar karein: Aap aam taur par pooche jaane wale sawalon aur unka jawab kaise dena hai, iski samiksha karke zyada tar sambhavit interview sawalon ke liye taiyari kar sakte hain. Kuch aisi kahaniyan taiyar karna khaas taur par madadgar ho sakta hai jo aapke vishisht skills ya problem-solving abilities ko darshata hai.

8. Apni pasand ki industry mein network banayein: Networking aksar job seekers ke liye ek badi madad hoti hai aur yeh ek aisa skill hai jiski zaroorat kai logon ko apne careers ke liye hoti hai. Chahe aap apne maujooda field mein ek naya mauka dhoondh rahe hon ya aap ek naye field mein career shuru karne ki umeed kar rahe hon, aapko us industry ke anya professionals se milne mein shayad fayda hoga.

Job searching process romanchak aur chunautipurn ho sakta hai, lekin aapki maujooda situation ko dekhte hue yeh aapke liye zaroori hai. Aapki job-hunting ke liye good luck!
texts.output_2:
Main aapko is situation se nipatne ke liye kuch sujhav de sakta hoon:

1. Colleague se seedhe baat karein: Us colleague se seedhe baat karna zaroori hai jo aapka mazak uda raha hai.

2. Apne liye khade hon: Apni baat rakhne se na daren aur doosron ko batayein jab unka behavior anuchit ho.

3. Situation mein humor dhoondhne ki koshish karein: Agar colleague ka humor halka-phulka hai, to aap iska mazak banakar situation ko shaant karne ki koshish kar sakte hain.

4. Doosron se support lein: Apne coworkers ya HR representative se is situation ke baare mein baat karein aur dekhein ki kya ve koi support de sakte hain.

5. Professional help lene par vichar karein: Agar colleague ka behavior aapke mental health ya work performance ko prabhavit kar raha hai, to aap kisi therapist ya counselor se madad lene par vichar kar sakte hain.

Yaad rakhein, workplace mein apne mental health aur bhalai ki raksha karna zaroori hai. Agar aapko lagta hai ki aapke rights ka ullanghan ho raha hai to action lene se na daren.
